script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars, your ruling planet and the engine of fire, is in your 1st House of Self forming a tense square to Saturn in your 12th House of the Subconscious, forcing you to confront buried fears that are blocking your forward momentum. Venus in your 2nd House of Values is sextiling Jupiter in your 5th House of Romance, which means single Aries could attract someone through a shared creative or intellectual passion, while partnered Aries should plan a date that surprises their lover. That same Venus-Jupiter sextile is lighting up your 2nd House of Money, so a financial opportunity tied to your talents could present itself by midday—don't dismiss it. Avoid signing any contract before 3 PM, because Mercury opposing Pluto in your 8th House of Shared Resources could cause you to overcommit to a toxic arrangement. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
